data.name: Khairaat
data.gender_notes: Khairaat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khair', meaning 'good' or 'excellence'. In Islam, 'khair' is a concept that embodies mercy, kindness, and good deeds. The name Khairaat signifies a woman who embodies these virtues. The name Khairaat carries the meaning “Excellence, Mercy, Kindness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khairaat usually hope their child will grow to embody excellence, mercy, kindness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality, symbolizing the pursuit of good deeds and the attainment of God's mercy.
data.etymology: Khairaat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Excellence, Mercy, Kindness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khairaat total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
